body:
Hi there,

I spent some time on your website this week, and something looks broken. Your homepage repeats the same heading, "Knowledge & Proven Results," over and over where your different selling points should be, and your main headline shows up three times in a row. Then I clicked your Reviews page, and it is completely empty.

For a licensed, insured, and BBB accredited company that offers free estimates with no long-term contracts, that first impression undersells you.

So I redesigned your homepage, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. Your services get their own clear sections, your free estimates and no-contract promise sit up top where people actually see them, and your call and text numbers are always one tap away.

Pest control sites are familiar ground for me. I worked on the website for Ecola Termite and Pest Control (ecolatermite.com), built around clear services and easy contact. I also worked on Orkin's Find Pest Pros pages (orkin.findpestpros.com), which help homeowners find a local pest professional fast.

If you like the redesign, I can put it on your real domain and clean up the rest of the pages too. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings either way.

Best,
Hassan
name: Lizard Lick Pest Control
subject: 🦎 Lizard Lick, your Reviews page has no reviews on it
